target_product.review_text: It is not an induction one, but a regular electric style that works with any type of cookware.  I use it most often when I'm cooking on the grill.  I like having fresh corn or green beans that are not dry roasted on the grill.  In other words I like grilled meats, but juicy veggies.  So I have a table next to the grill where I eat, but it also works for this induction stove and while the meat is grilling, I boil corn on the cob or a bunch of fresh green beans.  In summer, cooking outside helps keep the house cool and hey, having a picnic outside is fun!  This induction stovetop is more powerful than the other stovetop I have - means that I can get my corn cooked faster and that's a good thing!  I do like having this as my "outdoor stove" during the summer, but it would work well for a college student (if they are careful in their dorm) and for an office with a break/lunch room, this might be good for those who want to heat up a can of soup or something similar but don't want to use a microwave.
